sentences.zh: 於是尹征、王恒、盧異、盧士式、賈邕、趙匡、閻士和、柳並等皆執弟子禮，以次授業，號蕭夫子。

translations.literal: Then Yin Zheng, Wang Heng, Lu Yi, Lu Shishi, Jia Yong, Zhao Kuang, Yan Shihe, Liu Bing, and others all performed the rites of disciples in order of seniority — he was called Master Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: Then Yin Zheng, Wang Heng, Lu Yi, Lu Shishi, Jia Yong, Zhao Kuang, Yan Shihe, Liu Bing, and others all performed the rites of disciples in order of seniority — he was called Master Xiao.

sentences.zh: 召為集賢校理。

translations.literal: He was summoned as collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 宰相李林甫欲見之，穎士方父喪，不詣。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Li Linfu wished to see him, but Yingshi was in mourning for his father and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Chief minister Li Linfu wished to see him, but Yingshi was in mourning for his father and did not go.

sentences.zh: 林甫嘗至故人舍邀潁士，穎士前往，哭門內以待，林甫不得已，前吊乃去。

translations.literal: Linfu once came to an old friend's house to invite Yingshi; Yingshi went ahead and waited weeping inside the gate — Linfu had no choice but to enter and offer condolences before leaving.
translations.idiomatic: Linfu once came to an old friend's house to invite Yingshi; Yingshi went ahead and waited weeping inside the gate — Linfu had no choice but to enter and offer condolences before leaving.

sentences.zh: 怒其不下己，調廣陵參軍事，穎士急中不能堪，作《伐櫻桃樹賦》曰：「擢無庸之瑣質，蒙本枝以自庇。

translations.literal: Angry that Yingshi would not defer to him, he transferred him to military aide of Guangling; Yingshi, in acute distress, could not bear it and wrote "Ode on Felling the Cherry Tree," saying: "Raised is a petty quality without use, sheltered by the main branch for self-protection."
translations.idiomatic: Angry that Yingshi would not defer to him, he transferred him to military aide of Guangling; Yingshi, in acute distress, wrote "Ode on Felling the Cherry Tree," saying, "Raised is a petty quality without use, sheltered by the main branch for self-protection."

sentences.zh: 雖先寢而或薦，非和羹之正味。

translations.literal: "Though sometimes presented before the feast, it is not the right flavor for harmony."
translations.idiomatic: "Though sometimes presented before the feast, it is not the right flavor for harmony."

sentences.zh: 」以譏林甫雲。

translations.literal: — to satirize Linfu.
translations.idiomatic: — to satirize Linfu.

sentences.zh: 君子恨其褊。

translations.literal: Men of refinement resented his narrowness.
translations.idiomatic: Men of refinement resented his narrowness.

sentences.zh: 會母喪免，流播吳、越。

translations.literal: When his mother's mourning ended he was dismissed and wandered through Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother's mourning ended he was dismissed and wandered through Wu and Yue.

sentences.zh: 嘗謂：「仲尼作《春秋》，為百王不易法，而司馬遷作本紀、書、表、世家、列傳，敘事依違，失褒貶體，不足以訓。

translations.literal: He once said: "Confucius composed the Spring and Autumn Annals as the unchanging law for a hundred kings, yet Sima Qian composed Basic Annals, Treatises, Tables, Hereditary Houses, and Biographies — his narrative is inconsistent and loses the body of praise and blame, insufficient to instruct."
translations.idiomatic: He once said, "Confucius composed the Spring and Autumn Annals as the unchanging law for a hundred kings, yet Sima Qian composed basic annals, treatises, tables, hereditary houses, and biographies — his narrative is inconsistent and loses the body of praise and blame, insufficient to instruct."

sentences.zh: 」乃起漢元年訖隋義寧編年，依《春秋》義類為傳百篇。

translations.literal: He then began a chronicle from the first year of Han to the end of Sui's Yining, arranging by year according to the categories of the Spring and Autumn Annals into a hundred chapters of biography.
translations.idiomatic: He then began a chronicle from the first year of Han to the end of Sui's Yining, arranging by year according to the categories of the Spring and Autumn Annals into a hundred chapters of biography.

sentences.zh: 在魏書高貴崩，曰：「司馬昭弑帝于南闕。

translations.literal: In the Wei History at the death of the High and Noble Emperor he wrote: "Sima Zhao murdered the emperor at the southern gate."
translations.idiomatic: In the Wei History at the death of the High and Noble Emperor he wrote, "Sima Zhao murdered the emperor at the southern gate."

sentences.zh: 」在梁書陳受禪，曰：「陳霸先反。

translations.literal: In the Liang History at Chen's receiving the abdication he wrote: "Chen Baxian rebelled."
translations.idiomatic: In the Liang History at Chen's receiving the abdication he wrote, "Chen Baxian rebelled."

sentences.zh: 」又自以梁枝孫，而宣帝逆取順守，故武帝得血食三紀；

translations.literal: He also considered himself a collateral descendant of Liang and that Emperor Xuan had taken the throne by force against the way of yielding — therefore Emperor Wu received blood sacrifices for three reigns;
translations.idiomatic: He also considered himself a collateral descendant of Liang and that Emperor Xuan had taken the throne by force against the way of yielding — therefore Emperor Wu received blood sacrifices for three reigns;

sentences.zh: 昔曲沃篡晉，而文公為五伯，仲尼弗貶也。

translations.literal: In antiquity Quwo usurped Jin yet Duke Wen became one of the Five Hegemons — Confucius did not demean him.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity Quwo usurped Jin yet Duke Wen became one of the Five Hegemons — Confucius did not demean him.

sentences.zh: 乃黜陳閏隋，以唐土德承梁火德，皆自斷，諸儒不與論也。

translations.literal: He then demoted Chen, Min, and Sui, and had Tang's earth virtue succeed Liang's fire virtue — all by his own judgment; the scholars did not debate with him.
translations.idiomatic: He then demoted Chen, Min, and Sui, and had Tang's earth virtue succeed Liang's fire virtue — all by his own judgment; the scholars did not debate with him.

sentences.zh: 有太原王緒者，僧辯裔孫，撰《永甯公輔梁書》，黜陳不帝，穎士佐之，亦著《梁蕭史譜》及作《梁不禪陳論》以發緒義例，使光明雲。

translations.literal: There was Wang Xu of Taiyuan, collateral descendant of Wang Sengbian, who compiled the "Yongning Duke's Supplement to the Liang History," demoting Chen from imperial status — Yingshi assisted him and also wrote the "Liang Xiao Genealogy" and composed "On Liang's Not Ceding to Chen" to develop Xu's principles, making the meaning luminous.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xu of Taiyuan, collateral descendant of Wang Sengbian, compiled the Yongning Duke's Supplement to the Liang History, demoting Chen from imperial status — Yingshi assisted him and also wrote the Liang Xiao Genealogy and composed On Liang's Not Ceding to Chen to develop Xu's principles.

sentences.zh: 史官韋述薦穎士自代，召詣史館待制，穎士乘傳詣京師。

translations.literal: Historiographer Wei Shu recommended Yingshi to succeed him; he was summoned to the History Office as awaiting orders, and Yingshi traveled by post to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Historiographer Wei Shu recommended Yingshi to succeed him; he was summoned to the history office as awaiting orders, and Yingshi traveled by post to the capital.

sentences.zh: 而林甫方威福自擅，穎士遂不屈，愈見疾，俄免官，往來鄠、杜間。

translations.literal: But Linfu was then monopolizing power and arrogance; Yingshi would not submit and was increasingly disliked, soon dismissed from office, traveling between E and Du.
translations.idiomatic: But Linfu was then monopolizing power; Yingshi would not submit and was increasingly disliked, soon dismissed from office, traveling between E and Du.

sentences.zh: 林甫死，更調河南府參軍事。

translations.literal: When Linfu died he was transferred again to military aide of the Henan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Linfu died he was transferred again to military aide of the Henan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 倭國遣使入朝，自陳國人願得蕭夫子為師者，中書舍人張漸等諫不可而止。

translations.literal: Wa sent envoys to court who stated that their countrymen wished to have Master Xiao as teacher — Palace Draftsman Zhang Jian and others remonstrated that it could not be done and it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Wa sent envoys to court who stated that their countrymen wished to have Master Xiao as teacher — palace draftsman Zhang Jian and others remonstrated that it could not be done and it was stopped.

sentences.zh: 安祿山寵恣，穎士陰語柳並曰：「胡人負寵而驕，亂不久矣。

translations.literal: An Lushan was favored and arrogant; Yingshi said privately to Liu Bing: "The barbarian relies on favor and is arrogant — rebellion will not be long."
translations.idiomatic: An Lushan was favored and arrogant; Yingshi said privately to Liu Bing, "The barbarian relies on favor and is arrogant — rebellion will not be long."

sentences.zh: 東京其先陷乎！

translations.literal: The eastern capital will be the first to fall!
translations.idiomatic: The eastern capital will be the first to fall!

sentences.zh: 」即托疾遊太室山。

translations.literal: He then pleaded illness and traveled to Mount Taishi.
translations.idiomatic: He then pleaded illness and traveled to Mount Taishi.

sentences.zh: 已而祿山反，穎士往見河南採訪使郭納，言禦守計，納忽不用，歎曰：「肉食者以兒戲禦劇賊，難矣哉！

translations.literal: Soon Lushan rebelled; Yingshi went to see Henan investigating commissioner Guo Na and presented plans for defense — Na suddenly did not use them — Yingshi sighed: "Those who eat meat treat a fierce rebel as child's play — this will be hard!"
translations.idiomatic: Soon Lushan rebelled; Yingshi went to see Henan investigating commissioner Guo Na and presented plans for defense — Na suddenly did not use them — Yingshi sighed, "Those who eat meat treat a fierce rebel as child's play — this will be hard!"

sentences.zh: 」聞封常清陳兵東京，往觀之，不宿而還。

translations.literal: He heard that Feng Changqing was deploying troops at the eastern capital and went to observe; he did not stay overnight and returned.
translations.idiomatic: He heard that Feng Changqing was deploying troops at the eastern capital and went to observe; he did not stay overnight and returned.

sentences.zh: 因藏家書於箕、穎間，身走山南，節度使源洧辟掌書記。

translations.literal: He therefore hid his family books between Ji and Ying and himself fled to the southern mountains; Military Commissioner Yuan Wei recruited him as recorder.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore hid his family books between Ji and Ying and himself fled to the southern mountains; military commissioner Yuan Wei recruited him as recorder.

sentences.zh: 賊別校攻南陽，洧懼，欲退保江陵，穎士說曰：「官兵守潼關，財用急，必待江、淮轉餉乃足，餉道由漢、沔，則襄陽乃今天下喉襟，一日不守，則大事去矣。

translations.literal: When rebel detachments attacked Nanyang, Wei was afraid and wished to retreat and hold Jiangling; Yingshi urged: "The army now guards Tong Pass and urgently needs funds — it must wait for Jiang-Huai transport to be sufficient; the supply route runs through Han and Mian, so Xiangyang is today the throat of the realm — one day without defense and the great affair is lost."
translations.idiomatic: When rebel detachments attacked Nanyang, Wei was afraid and wished to retreat and hold Jiangling; Yingshi urged, "The army now guards Tong Pass and urgently needs funds — it must wait for Jiang-Huai transport to be sufficient; the supply route runs through Han and Mian, so Xiangyang is today the throat of the realm — one day without defense and the great affair is lost."

sentences.zh: 且列郡數十，人百萬，訓兵攘寇，社稷之功也。

translations.literal: Moreover there are dozens of prefectures and a million people — training troops and repelling bandits is merit for the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover there are dozens of prefectures and a million people — training troops and repelling bandits is merit for the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 賊方專崤、陝，公何遽輕土地，欲取笑天下乎？

translations.literal: The rebels are now focused on Xiao and Shan — why do you so hastily slight the land and wish to make the realm laugh?
translations.idiomatic: The rebels are now focused on Xiao and Shan — why do you so hastily slight the land and wish to make the realm laugh?

sentences.zh: 」洧乃按甲不出。

translations.literal: Wei then held his troops and did not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Wei then held his troops and did not advance.

sentences.zh: 亦會祿山死，賊解去。

translations.literal: It happened that Lushan died and the rebels dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Lushan died and the rebels dispersed.

sentences.zh: 洧卒，往客金陵，永王璘召之，不見。

translations.literal: When Wei died Yingshi went as guest to Jinling; Prince of Yong Li Lin summoned him but he did not appear.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei died Yingshi went as guest to Jinling; Prince of Yong Li Lin summoned him but he did not appear.

sentences.zh: 時盛王為淮南節度大使，留蜀不遣，副大使李承式玩兵不振。

translations.literal: At the time Prince of Sheng was military commissioner of Huainan, detained in Shu and not sent; Deputy Commissioner Li Chengshi played at troops without rousing them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Prince of Sheng was military commissioner of Huainan, detained in Shu and not sent; deputy commissioner Li Chengshi played at troops without rousing them.

sentences.zh: 穎士與宰相崔圓書，以為：「今兵食所資在東南，但楚、越重山復江，自古中原擾則盜先起，宜時遣王以捍鎮江淮。

translations.literal: Yingshi wrote to Chief Minister Cui Yuan, arguing: "Today military grain is supplied from the southeast — but Chu and Yue have layered mountains and doubled rivers; since antiquity when the central plains are disturbed bandits rise first — the prince should be sent in season to defend and hold the Jiang-Huai."
translations.idiomatic: Yingshi wrote to chief minister Cui Yuan, arguing, "Today military grain is supplied from the southeast — but Chu and Yue have layered mountains and doubled rivers; since antiquity when the central plains are disturbed bandits rise first — the prince should be sent in season to defend and hold the Jiang-Huai."

sentences.zh: 」俄而劉展果反。

translations.literal: Before long Liu Zhan indeed rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Liu Zhan indeed rebelled.

sentences.zh: 賊圍雍丘，脅泗上軍，承式遣兵往救，大宴賓客，陳女樂。

translations.literal: Rebels besieged Yongqiu and threatened the Si River army; Chengshi sent troops to rescue and gave a great banquet for guests with female musicians.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels besieged Yongqiu and threatened the Si River army; Chengshi sent troops to rescue and gave a great banquet for guests with female musicians.

sentences.zh: 穎士曰：「天子暴露，豈臣下盡歡時邪？

translations.literal: Yingshi said: "The Son of Heaven is exposed to the elements — is this the time for ministers to feast to the full?"
translations.idiomatic: Yingshi said, "The Son of Heaven is exposed to the elements — is this the time for ministers to feast to the full?"

sentences.zh: 夫投兵不測，乃使觀聽華麗，一旦思歸，誰致其死哉？

translations.literal: To send troops into uncertainty while making the sights and sounds splendid — if they once think of returning, who will fight to the death?
translations.idiomatic: To send troops into uncertainty while making the sights and sounds splendid — if they once think of returning, who will fight to the death?

sentences.zh: 」弗納。

translations.literal: He was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: He was not accepted.

sentences.zh: 崔圓聞之，即授揚州功曹參軍。

translations.literal: When Cui Yuan heard of it he immediately appointed him grain-store secretary of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Cui Yuan heard of it he immediately appointed him grain-store secretary of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 至官，信宿去。

translations.literal: When he reached office he left after one or two nights.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached office he left after one or two nights.

sentences.zh: 後客死汝南逆旅，年五十二，門人共諡曰文元先生。

translations.literal: He later died as a guest in a Runnan inn, aged fifty-two; his disciples together gave the posthumous title "Master of Literary Origin."
translations.idiomatic: He later died as a guest in a Runnan inn, aged fifty-two; his disciples together gave the posthumous title "Master of Literary Origin."

sentences.zh: 穎士樂聞人善，以推引後進為己任，如李陽、李幼卿、皇甫冉、陸渭等數十人，由獎目，皆為名士。

translations.literal: Yingshi delighted in hearing of others' excellence and took recommending later men as his own task — Li Yang, Li Youqing, Huangfu Ran, Lu Wei, and several dozen others, through his praise, all became celebrated men.
translations.idiomatic: Yingshi delighted in hearing of others' excellence and took recommending later men as his own task — Li Yang, Li Youqing, Huangfu Ran, Lu Wei, and several dozen others, through his praise, all became celebrated men.

sentences.zh: 天下推知人，稱蕭功曹。

translations.literal: The realm acclaimed him for knowing men — he was called "Assistant Xiao."
translations.idiomatic: The realm acclaimed him for knowing men — he was called "Assistant Xiao."

sentences.zh: 嘗兄事元德秀，而友殷寅、顏真卿、柳芳、陸據、李華、邵軫、趙驊，時人語曰「殷、顏、柳、陸，李、蕭、邵、趙」，以能全其交也。

translations.literal: He once treated Yuan Dexiu as elder brother and befriended Yin Yin, Yan Zhenqing, Liu Fang, Lu Ju, Li Hua, Shao Zhen, and Zhao Hua — people said "Yin, Yan, Liu, Lu, Li, Xiao, Shao, Zhao" — for they could preserve their friendships.
translations.idiomatic: He once treated Yuan Dexiu as elder brother and befriended Yin Yin, Yan Zhenqing, Liu Fang, Lu Ju, Li Hua, Shao Zhen, and Zhao Hua — people said "Yin, Yan, Liu, Lu, Li, Xiao, Shao, Zhao" — for they could preserve their friendships.

sentences.zh: 所與游者，孔至、賈至、源行恭、張有略、族弟季遐、劉穎、韓拯、陳晉、孫益、韋建、韋收。

translations.literal: Those with whom he associated included Kong Zhi, Jia Zhi, Yuan Xinggong, Zhang Youlue, his cousin Ji Xia, Liu Ying, Han Zheng, Chen Jin, Sun Yi, Wei Jian, Wei Shou.
translations.idiomatic: Those with whom he associated included Kong Zhi, Jia Zhi, Yuan Xinggong, Zhang Youlue, his cousin Ji Xia, Liu Ying, Han Zheng, Chen Jin, Sun Yi, Wei Jian, and Wei Shou.

sentences.zh: 獨華與齊名，世號「蕭、李」。

translations.literal: Only Hua was his equal in fame — the age called them "Xiao and Li."
translations.idiomatic: Only Hua matched him in fame — the age called them "Xiao and Li."

sentences.zh: 嘗與華、據游洛龍門，讀路旁碑，穎士即誦，華再閱，據三乃能盡記。

translations.literal: Once while traveling with Hua and Ju at Longmen in Luoyang, reading a roadside stele, Yingshi recited it at once; Hua needed a second reading and Ju three before he could remember it all.
translations.idiomatic: Once at Longmen in Luoyang with Hua and Ju, reading a roadside stele, Yingshi recited it at once; Hua needed a second reading and Ju three before he could remember it all.

sentences.zh: 聞者謂三人才高下，此其分也。

translations.literal: Those who heard said this showed the gradations of the three men's talent.
translations.idiomatic: Those who heard said this showed the gradations of the three men's talent.

sentences.zh: 有奴事穎士十年，笞楚嚴慘，或勸其去，答曰：「非不能，愛其才耳。

translations.literal: A servant who had served Yingshi ten years was beaten severely; some urged him to leave — he answered: "It is not that I cannot — I love his talent."
translations.idiomatic: A servant who had served Yingshi ten years was beaten severely; some urged him to leave — he answered, "It is not that I cannot — I love his talent."

sentences.zh: 」穎士數稱班彪、皇甫謐、張華、劉琨、潘尼能尚古，而混流俗不自振，曹植、陸機所不逮也；

translations.literal: Yingshi often praised Ban Biao, Huangfu Mi, Zhang Hua, Liu Kun, and Pan Ni for honoring antiquity while mixing with the vulgar without losing themselves — what Cao Zhi and Lu Ji could not attain;
translations.idiomatic: Yingshi often praised Ban Biao, Huangfu Mi, Zhang Hua, Liu Kun, and Pan Ni for honoring antiquity while mixing with the vulgar without losing themselves — what Cao Zhi and Lu Ji could not attain;

sentences.zh: 又言裴子野善著書。

translations.literal: He also said Pei Ziye was skilled at writing books.
translations.idiomatic: He also said Pei Ziye was skilled at writing books.

sentences.zh: 所許可當世者，陳子昂、富嘉謨、盧藏用之文辭，董南事、孔述睿之博學而已。

translations.literal: Those he approved in his age were only the literary style of Chen Zi'ang, Fu Jiamou, and Lu Zangyong, and the erudition of Dong Nanshi and Kong Shurui.
translations.idiomatic: Those he approved in his age were only the literary style of Chen Zi'ang, Fu Jiamou, and Lu Zangyong, and the erudition of Dong Nanshi and Kong Shurui.

sentences.zh: 子 存子存，字伯誠，亮直有父風。

translations.literal: His son Cun, styled Bocheng, was upright and had his father's manner.
translations.idiomatic: His son Cun, courtesy name Bocheng, was upright and had his father's manner.

sentences.zh: 能文辭，與韓會、沈既濟、梁肅、徐岱等善。

translations.literal: He was skilled at literary composition and befriended Han Hui, Shen Jiji, Liang Su, Xu Dai, and others.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled at literary composition and befriended Han Hui, Shen Jiji, Liang Su, Xu Dai, and others.

sentences.zh: 浙西觀察使李棲筠表常熟主簿。

translations.literal: Military Commissioner of the Zhexi Circuit Li Qiyun recommended him as chief clerk of Changshu.
translations.idiomatic: Military commissioner of the Zhexi circuit Li Qiyun recommended him as chief clerk of Changshu.

sentences.zh: 顏真卿在湖州，與存及陸鴻漸等討摭古今韻字所原，作書數百篇。

translations.literal: When Yan Zhenqing was in Huzhou, with Cun and Lu Hongjian and others he collected and arranged the origins of ancient and modern rhyme characters, composing several hundred chapters.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan Zhenqing was in Huzhou, with Cun and Lu Hongjian and others he collected and arranged the origins of ancient and modern rhyme characters, composing several hundred chapters.

sentences.zh: 建中初，由殿中侍御史四遷比部郎中。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianzhong, through four promotions from Palace Censor he became Bureau Director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianzhong, through four promotions from palace censor he became bureau director in the ministry of justice.

sentences.zh: 張滂主財賦，辟存留務京師。

translations.literal: Zhang Pang was in charge of finance and revenue and recruited Cun to remain and handle affairs at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pang was in charge of finance and revenue and recruited Cun to remain and handle affairs at the capital.

sentences.zh: 裴延齡與滂不協，存疾其奸，去官，風痹卒。

translations.literal: Pei Yanling was at odds with Pang; Cun hated his wickedness, resigned office, and died of wind paralysis.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Yanling was at odds with Pang; Cun hated his wickedness, resigned office, and died of wind paralysis.

sentences.zh: 韓愈少為存所知，自袁州還，過存廬山故居，而諸子前死，唯一女在，為經贍其家。

translations.literal: Han Yu in his youth was known to Cun; returning from Yuan Prefecture he passed Cun's old residence on Mount Lu — all the sons had died before him and only one daughter remained — and he provided for the family.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu in his youth was known to Cun; returning from Yuan Prefecture he passed Cun's old residence on Mount Lu — all the sons had died before him and only one daughter remained — and he provided for the family.

sentences.zh: 殷寅者，陳郡人。

translations.literal: Yin Yin was a native of Chen Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Yin was a native of Chen Commandery.

sentences.zh: 邵軫者，汝南人。

translations.literal: Shao Zhen was a native of Runan.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Zhen was a native of Runan.

sentences.zh: 附 陸據陸據，河南人，字德鄰，後周上庸公騰六世孫。

translations.literal: Appendix — Lu Ju, a native of Henan, styled Delin, was sixth-generation descendant of Duke Teng of Shangyong of Northern Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Appendix: Lu Ju, a native of Henan, courtesy name Delin, was sixth-generation descendant of Duke Teng of Shangyong of Northern Zhou.

sentences.zh: 神宇警邁，善物理。

translations.literal: His bearing was alert and lofty; he was skilled at natural principles.
translations.idiomatic: His bearing was alert and lofty; he was skilled at natural principles.

sentences.zh: 年三十始到京師，公卿愛其文，交譽之。

translations.literal: At thirty he first reached the capital; the nobles loved his writing and praised him in mutual recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: At thirty he first reached the capital; the nobles loved his writing and praised him in mutual recommendation.

sentences.zh: 天寶十三載，終司勳員外郎。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tianbao he died as Vice Director in the Bureau of Merits.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao 13 he died as vice director in the bureau of merits.

sentences.zh: 附 柳並柳並者，字伯存。

translations.literal: Appendix — Liu Bing, styled Bocun.
translations.idiomatic: Appendix: Liu Bing, courtesy name Bocun.

sentences.zh: 大曆中，辟河東府掌書記，遷殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: In the Dali era he was recruited as recorder of the Hedong command and promoted to Palace Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dali era he was recruited as recorder of the Hedong command and promoted to palace censor.

sentences.zh: 喪明，終於家。

translations.literal: He went blind and died at home.
translations.idiomatic: He went blind and died at home.

sentences.zh: 初，並與劉太真、尹征、閻士和受業於穎士，而並好黃老。

translations.literal: At first Bing together with Liu Taizhen, Yin Zheng, and Yan Shihe studied under Yingshi, and Bing favored Huang-Lao.
translations.idiomatic: At first Bing together with Liu Taizhen, Yin Zheng, and Yan Shihe studied under Yingshi, and Bing favored Huang-Lao.

sentences.zh: 穎士常曰：「太真，吾入室者也，斯文不墜，寄是子雲。

translations.literal: Yingshi often said: "Taizhen is one who has entered my inner chamber — that this tradition does not fall rests with this Ziyun."
translations.idiomatic: Yingshi often said, "Taizhen is one who has entered my inner chamber — that this tradition does not fall rests with this Ziyun."

sentences.zh: 征博聞強識，士和鉤深致遠，吾弗逮已。

translations.literal: Zheng's learning is broad and memory strong; Shihe probes deep and reaches far — I cannot match them.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng's learning is broad and memory strong; Shihe probes deep and reaches far — I cannot match them.

sentences.zh: 並不受命而尚黃、老，予亦何誅？

translations.literal: Bing does not accept the mandate yet honors Huang and Lao — what fault can I find?
translations.idiomatic: Bing does not accept the mandate yet honors Huang and Lao — what fault can I find?

sentences.zh: 並弟談，字中庸，穎士愛其才，以女妻之。

translations.literal: Bing's younger brother Tan, styled Zhongyong, Yingshi loved his talent and gave him his daughter in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Bing's younger brother Tan, courtesy name Zhongyong, Yingshi loved his talent and gave him his daughter in marriage.

sentences.zh: 士和字伯均，著《蘭陵先生誄》、《蕭夫子集論》，因榷曆世文章，而盛推穎士所長，以為「聞蕭氏風者，五尺童子羞稱曹、陸」。

translations.literal: Shihe, styled Bojun, wrote "Eulogy for Master Lanling" and "Collected Essays on Master Xiao," weighing literary works through the ages and greatly praising Yingshi's strengths, holding that "those who have heard the Xiao style — a boy of five feet would be ashamed to name Cao and Lu."
translations.idiomatic: Shihe, courtesy name Bojun, wrote "Eulogy for Master Lanling" and "Collected Essays on Master Xiao," weighing literary works through the ages and greatly praising Yingshi's strengths, holding that "those who have heard the Xiao style — a boy of five feet would be ashamed to name Cao and Lu."

sentences.zh: 附 皇甫冉皇甫冉，字茂政，十歲便能屬文，張九齡歎異之。

translations.literal: Appendix — Huangfu Ran, styled Maozheng, could compose prose at ten; Zhang Jiuling sighed in wonder.
translations.idiomatic: Appendix: Huangfu Ran, courtesy name Maozheng, could compose prose at ten; Zhang Jiuling sighed in wonder.

sentences.zh: 與弟曾皆善詩。

translations.literal: He and his younger brother Zeng were both skilled at poetry.
translations.idiomatic: He and his younger brother Zeng were both skilled at poetry.

sentences.zh: 天寶中，踵登進士，授無錫尉。

translations.literal: During Tianbao they both passed the jinshi examination in succession; he was appointed assistant magistrate of Wuxi.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianbao they both passed the jinshi examination in succession; he was appointed assistant magistrate of Wuxi.

sentences.zh: 王縉為河南元帥，表掌書記。

translations.literal: Wang Jin as commander of Henan recommended him as recorder.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jin as commander of Henan recommended him as recorder.

sentences.zh: 遷累右補闕，卒。

translations.literal: Through successive promotions he became Right Supplementation Censor and died.
translations.idiomatic: Through successive promotions he became right supplementation censor and died.

sentences.zh: 曾，字孝常，曆監察御史。

translations.literal: Zeng, styled Xiaochang, served as Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng, courtesy name Xiaochang, served as investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 其名與冉相上下，當時比張氏景陽、孟陽雲。

translations.literal: His fame was about equal to Ran's; at the time they were compared to Zhang Jingyang and Mengyang.
translations.idiomatic: His fame was about equal to Ran's; at the time they were compared to Zhang Jingyang and Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 蘇源明蘇源明，京兆武功人，初名預，字弱夫。

translations.literal: Su Yuanming, a native of Wugong in Jingzhao, originally named Yu, styled Ruofu.
translations.idiomatic: Su Yuanming, a native of Wugong in Jingzhao, originally named Yu, courtesy name Ruofu.

sentences.zh: 少孤，寓居徐、兗。

translations.literal: Orphaned young, he lived as a guest in Xu and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young, he lived as a guest in Xu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 工文辭，有名天寶間。

translations.literal: Skilled at literary composition, he was famed during the Tianbao era.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled at literary composition, he was famed during the Tianbao era.

sentences.zh: 及進士第，更試集賢院。

translations.literal: After passing the jinshi examination he was further examined at the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: After passing the jinshi examination he was further examined at the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 累遷太子諭德。

translations.literal: Through successive promotions he became Mentor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Through successive promotions he became mentor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 出為東平太守。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as prefect of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 是時，濟陽郡太守李倰以郡瀕河，請增領宿城、中都二縣以紓民力。

translations.literal: At the time Li Tong, prefect of Jiyang Commandery, because the commandery bordered the river requested to add the two counties of Sucheng and Zhongdu to ease the people's burden.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Li Tong, prefect of Jiyang commandery, because the commandery bordered the river requested to add the two counties of Sucheng and Zhongdu to ease the people's burden.

sentences.zh: 二縣，隸東平、魯郡者也。

translations.literal: The two counties were subordinate to Dongping and Lu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The two counties were subordinate to Dongping and Lu commandery.

sentences.zh: 於是源明議廢濟陽，析三縣分隸濟南、東平、濮陽。

translations.literal: Yuanming then proposed abolishing Jiyang and dividing the three counties to be subordinate to Jinan, Dongping, and Puyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanming then proposed abolishing Jiyang and dividing the three counties to be subordinate to Jinan, Dongping, and Puyang.

sentences.zh: 詔河南採訪使會濮陽太守崔季重、魯郡太守李蘭、濟南太守田琦及源明、倰五太守議于東平，不能決。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Henan investigating commissioner to convene Puyang Prefect Cui Jizhong, Lu Prefect Li Lan, Jinan Prefect Tian Qi, and the five prefects Yuanming and Tong to deliberate at Dongping — they could not decide.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Henan investigating commissioner to convene Puyang prefect Cui Jizhong, Lu prefect Li Lan, Jinan prefect Tian Qi, and the five prefects Yuanming and Tong to deliberate at Dongping — they could not decide.

sentences.zh: 既而卒廢濟陽，以縣皆隸東平。

translations.literal: Soon Jiyang was abolished and all counties were subordinate to Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jiyang was abolished and all counties were subordinate to Dongping.

sentences.zh: 召源明為國子司業。

translations.literal: Yuanming was summoned as Vice Director of the National Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanming was summoned as vice director of the national academy.

sentences.zh: 安祿山陷京師，源明以病不受偽署。

translations.literal: When An Lushan seized the capital Yuanming, being ill, did not accept false appointment.
translations.idiomatic: When An Lushan seized the capital Yuanming, being ill, did not accept false appointment.

sentences.zh: 肅宗復兩京，擢考功郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: When Emperor Suzong recovered the two capitals he was promoted to Bureau Director in the Ministry of Personnel and Controller of Edicts.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Suzong recovered the two capitals he was promoted to bureau director in the ministry of personnel and controller of edicts.

sentences.zh: 是時，承大盜之余，國用覂屈，宰相王璵以祈禬進，禁中禱祀窮日夜，中官用事，給養繁靡，群臣莫敢切諍。

translations.literal: At the time, following the great plunder, state funds were exhausted; Chief Minister Wang Yu advanced through prayer and divination — within the palace prayers and sacrifices continued day and night, eunuchs held power, provisions were wastefully abundant, and no minister dared direct remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, following the great plunder, state funds were exhausted; chief minister Wang Yu advanced through prayer and divination — within the palace prayers and sacrifices continued day and night, eunuchs held power, provisions were wastefully abundant, and no minister dared direct remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 昭應令梁鎮上書勸帝罷淫祀，其他不暇及也。

translations.literal: Zhaoying Magistrate Liang Zhen submitted a memorial urging the emperor to cease excessive sacrifices — other matters could not be addressed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoying magistrate Liang Zhen submitted a memorial urging the emperor to cease excessive sacrifices — other matters could not be addressed.

sentences.zh: 源明數陳政治得失。

translations.literal: Yuanming repeatedly presented the gains and losses of government.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanming repeatedly presented the gains and losses of government.

sentences.zh: 及史思明陷洛陽，有詔幸東京，將親征。

translations.literal: When Shi Siming seized Luoyang there was an edict that the emperor would visit the eastern capital and personally campaign.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi Siming seized Luoyang there was an edict that the emperor would visit the eastern capital and personally campaign.

sentences.zh: 源明因上疏極諫曰：

translations.literal: Yuanming therefore submitted a memorial remonstrating to the utmost, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Yuanming therefore submitted a memorial remonstrating to the utmost, saying:

sentences.zh: 淫雨積時，道路方梗，甚不可一也。

translations.literal: Prolonged rain has accumulated — the roads are blocked — this is greatly inadvisable, first.
translations.idiomatic: Prolonged rain has accumulated — the roads are blocked — this is greatly inadvisable, first.

sentences.zh: 自春大旱，秋苗耗半，斂獲未畢，先之以清道之役，申之以供頓之苦，甚不可二也。

translations.literal: Since spring there has been great drought and autumn crops are half lost; the harvest is not yet complete — yet first comes the labor of clearing the roads, compounded by the hardship of provisioning — this is greatly inadvisable, second.
translations.idiomatic: Since spring there has been great drought and autumn crops are half lost; the harvest is not yet complete — yet first comes the labor of clearing the roads, compounded by the hardship of provisioning — this is greatly inadvisable, second.

sentences.zh: 每立殿廊，見旌旗之下，餓夫執殳，僕於行間，日見二三；

translations.literal: Each time I stand in the hall corridor and see beneath the banners hungry men holding halberds collapsing among the ranks — one or two each day;
translations.idiomatic: Each time I stand in the hall corridor and see beneath the banners hungry men holding halberds collapsing among the ranks — one or two each day;

sentences.zh: 市井餒𩛞求食，死于路旁，日見四五。

translations.literal: In the marketplace the starving seek food and die by the roadside — four or five each day.
translations.idiomatic: In the marketplace the starving seek food and die by the roadside — four or five each day.

sentences.zh: 甚不可三也。

translations.literal: This is greatly inadvisable, third.
translations.idiomatic: This is greatly inadvisable, third.

sentences.zh: 姦夫盜兒，連牆接棟，磨礪以須陛下之出，御史大夫必不能澄清禁止。

translations.literal: Adulterers and thieves connect wall to wall, sharpening blades awaiting Your Majesty's departure — the Censor-in-Chief surely cannot clarify and forbid this.
translations.idiomatic: Adulterers and thieves connect wall to wall, sharpening blades awaiting Your Majesty's departure — the censor-in-chief surely cannot clarify and forbid this.

sentences.zh: 甚不可四也。

translations.literal: This is greatly inadvisable, fourth.
translations.idiomatic: This is greatly inadvisable, fourth.

sentences.zh: 聖皇巡蜀之初，都內財貨、吏民資產，糜散于道路之手，至有乘馬駃驢入宣政、紫宸者。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Sacred Emperor's tour to Shu, capital goods and the property of officials and people were scattered into the hands of those on the road — there were even those who rode horses and donkeys into the Xuanzheng and Zichen halls.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Sacred Emperor's tour to Shu, capital goods and the property of officials and people were scattered into the hands of those on the road — there were even those who rode horses and donkeys into the Xuanzheng and Zichen halls.

sentences.zh: 況陛下初有四海，威制不及曩時遠矣。

translations.literal: Moreover Your Majesty has only recently possessed all within the four seas — your authority does not reach as far as in former times.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Your Majesty has only recently possessed all within the four seas — your authority does not reach as far as in former times.

sentences.zh: 今茲東行，殆賊臣誘掖陛下而已。

translations.literal: Now this eastern journey is likely only rebel ministers luring Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Now this eastern journey is likely only rebel ministers luring Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 《詩》曰「三星在霤」，謂危亡在於須臾，臣不勝嗚咽，為陛下痛之。

translations.literal: The Odes say "the three stars are in the window" — meaning peril is in an instant; I cannot restrain my sobbing and grieve for Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: The Odes say "the three stars are in the window" — meaning peril is in an instant; I cannot restrain my sobbing and grieve for Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 願速罷幸，不然，窮氓樂禍，已扼腕於下。

translations.literal: I wish you would quickly cease the journey — otherwise the destitute masses delight in calamity and already clench their fists below.
translations.idiomatic: I wish you would quickly cease the journey — otherwise the destitute masses delight in calamity and already clench their fists below.

sentences.zh: 甚不可五也。

translations.literal: This is greatly inadvisable, fifth.
translations.idiomatic: This is greatly inadvisable, fifth.

sentences.zh: 方今河、洛驛騷，江湖叛渙，《詩》曰：「中原有菽，庶民采之。

translations.literal: Now the He-Luo posts are in turmoil and the rivers and lakes are in rebellion — the Odes say: "In the central plains there are beans — the common people gather them."
translations.idiomatic: Now the He-Luo posts are in turmoil and the rivers and lakes are in rebellion — the Odes say, "In the central plains there are beans — the common people gather them."

sentences.zh: 」彼思明、楚元，皆采菽之人也。

translations.literal: Siming and Chu Yuan are both bean-gatherers.
translations.idiomatic: Siming and Chu Yuan are both bean-gatherers.

sentences.zh: 陛下何遽輕萬乘而速成之邪？

translations.literal: Why does Your Majesty so hastily slight the imperial carriage and hasten to deliver it to them?
translations.idiomatic: Why does Your Majesty so hastily slight the imperial carriage and hasten to deliver it to them?

sentences.zh: 甚不可六也。

translations.literal: This is greatly inadvisable, sixth.
translations.idiomatic: This is greatly inadvisable, sixth.

sentences.zh: 大河南北，舉為寇盜，王公以下，廩稍匱絕，將士糧賜，僅支日月，而中官冗食，不減往年，梨園雜伎，愈盛今日，陛下未得穆然高枕，殆繇此也。

translations.literal: North and south of the great river, all have become bandits; from kings and dukes downward, grain rations are exhausted; soldiers' pay and rewards barely last from month to month — yet eunuch supernumeraries are no fewer than in former years, Pear Garden miscellaneous performers are more flourishing than today — Your Majesty cannot rest peacefully on a high pillow, likely because of this.
translations.idiomatic: North and south of the great river, all have become bandits; from kings and dukes downward, grain rations are exhausted; soldiers' pay and rewards barely last from month to month — yet eunuch supernumeraries are no fewer than in former years, Pear Garden miscellaneous performers are more flourishing than today — Your Majesty cannot rest peacefully on a high pillow, likely because of this.

sentences.zh: 自非中庸指使，太常正樂外，願一切放歸，給長牒勿事，須五六年後，隨事蠲省。

translations.literal: Except for the Director of Ceremonial's proper music and the Director of Ceremonial's correct music, I wish all to be released and given long certificates of exemption from service — after five or six years reduce according to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: Except for the director of ceremonial's proper music and the director of ceremonial's correct music, I wish all to be released and given long certificates of exemption from service — after five or six years reduce according to circumstances.

sentences.zh: 今聚而仰給，甚不可七也。

translations.literal: Now they gather and live on state support — this is greatly inadvisable, seventh.
translations.idiomatic: Now they gather and live on state support — this is greatly inadvisable, seventh.

sentences.zh: 李光弼拔河陽，王思禮下晉原，衛伯玉拂焉耆，過析支，不日可至。

translations.literal: Li Guangbi took Heyang, Wang Sili took Jinyuan, Wei Boyu swept Yanqi and passed Qizhi — within days they can arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangbi took Heyang, Wang Sili took Jinyuan, Wei Boyu swept Yanqi and passed Qizhi — within days they can arrive.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫王玄志壓巫閭，臨幽都；

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Wang Xuanzhi presses Wulü and overlooks Youdu;
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Wang Xuanzhi presses Wulü and overlooks Youdu;

sentences.zh: 汝州刺史田南金逾闕口，遏二室；

translations.literal: Ying Prefect Tian Nanjin crosses Que Pass and blocks the two peaks;
translations.idiomatic: Ying prefect Tian Nanjin crosses Que Pass and blocks the two peaks;

sentences.zh: 鄧景山淩淮、泗，愾然而西。

translations.literal: Deng Jingshan crosses the Huai and Si and advances west with spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Jingshan crosses the Huai and Si and advances west with spirit.

sentences.zh: 狂賊失勢，蹙於緱山之下，北不敢逾孟津，東不敢過甖子，計日反接而至矣。

translations.literal: The mad rebels have lost momentum and are pressed beneath Mount Goushan — they dare not cross Meng Ford to the north or pass Pingzi to the east — within days they will be bound and delivered.
translations.idiomatic: The mad rebels have lost momentum and are pressed beneath Mount Goushan — they dare not cross Meng Ford to the north or pass Pingzi to the east — within days they will be bound and delivered.

sentences.zh: 陛下不坐而受之，乃欲親征，徇一朝之怒，甚不可八也。

translations.literal: Your Majesty need not campaign in person but can sit and receive them — yet you wish to campaign personally, indulging a moment's anger — this is greatly inadvisable, eighth.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty need not campaign in person but can sit and receive them — yet you wish to campaign personally, indulging a moment's anger — this is greatly inadvisable, eighth.

sentences.zh: 王者之於天地神祇，享之以牲幣而已。

translations.literal: The king's relation to heaven, earth, and the spirits is to offer them victims and silks — that is all.
translations.idiomatic: The king's relation to heaven, earth, and the spirits is to offer them victims and silks — that is all.

sentences.zh: 記曰：「不祈方士。

translations.literal: The Record says: "Do not pray to alchemists."
translations.idiomatic: The Record says, "Do not pray to alchemists."

sentences.zh: 」彼淫巫愚祝，妄有關說，甚不可九也。

translations.literal: Those lewd shamans and foolish invokers presumptuously make connections — this is greatly inadvisable, ninth.
translations.idiomatic: Those lewd shamans and foolish invokers presumptuously make connections — this is greatly inadvisable, ninth.

sentences.zh: 天子順動，人皆幸之之謂幸，人皆病之之謂不幸。

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven moves in accord, if all rejoice it is called fortune; if all are afflicted it is called misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: When the Son of Heaven moves in accord, if all rejoice it is called fortune; if all are afflicted it is called misfortune.

sentences.zh: 臣等屢怫視聽，聯伏赤墀之下，頓顙流涕而出，雖陛下優容貸罪，凡百之臣必昌言于朝，萬口謗於外，甚不可十也。

translations.literal: We ministers have repeatedly offended your sight and hearing, gathered prostrate below the red steps, bowed our heads and wept as we withdrew — though Your Majesty may generously pardon our crimes, every official will surely speak openly at court and ten thousand mouths will slander outside — this is greatly inadvisable, tenth.
translations.idiomatic: We ministers have repeatedly offended your sight and hearing, gathered prostrate below the red steps, bowed our heads and wept as we withdrew — though Your Majesty may generously pardon our crimes, every official will surely speak openly at court and ten thousand mouths will slander outside — this is greatly inadvisable, tenth.

sentences.zh: 臣聞子不諍于父，不孝也；

translations.literal: I have heard that a son who does not remonstrate with his father is unfilial;
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that a son who does not remonstrate with his father is unfilial;

sentences.zh: 臣不諍於君，不忠也。

translations.literal: A minister who does not remonstrate with his ruler is unloyal.
translations.idiomatic: A minister who does not remonstrate with his ruler is unloyal.

sentences.zh: 不孝不忠，為苟榮冒祿，圈牢之物不若也。

translations.literal: Unfilial and unloyal — to seek glory and accept salary is worse than a penned beast.
translations.idiomatic: Unfilial and unloyal — to seek glory and accept salary is worse than a penned beast.

sentences.zh: 臣雖至賤，不能委身圈牢之中，將使樵夫指而笑之。

translations.literal: Though I am most lowly, I cannot commit myself within a pen — I would be pointed at and laughed at by woodcutters.
translations.idiomatic: Though I am most lowly, I cannot commit myself within a pen — I would be pointed at and laughed at by woodcutters.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其切直，遂罷東幸。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his directness and forthrightness and ceased the eastern journey.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his directness and forthrightness and ceased the eastern journey.

sentences.zh: 後以秘書少監卒。

translations.literal: Later he died as Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Later he died as deputy director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 源明雅善杜甫、鄭虔，其最稱者元結、梁肅。

translations.literal: Yuanming was by nature good friends with Du Fu and Zheng Qian; those he most praised were Yuan Jie and Liang Su.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanming was by nature good friends with Du Fu and Zheng Qian; those he most praised were Yuan Jie and Liang Su.

sentences.zh: 附 梁肅肅，字敬之，一字寬中。

translations.literal: Appendix — Liang Su, styled Jingzhi, also styled Kuanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Appendix: Liang Su, courtesy name Jingzhi, also styled Kuanzhong.

sentences.zh: 隋刑部尚書毘五世孫，世居陸渾。

translations.literal: Fifth-generation descendant of Sui Minister of Justice Pi; the family had long lived in Luzhun.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth-generation descendant of Sui minister of justice Pi; the family had long lived in Luzhun.

sentences.zh: 建中初，中文辭清麗科，擢太子校書郎。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianzhong he passed the examination for refined literary composition and was promoted to Collator to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianzhong he passed the examination for refined literary composition and was promoted to collator to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 蕭復薦其材，授右拾遺，脩史，以母羸老不赴。

translations.literal: Xiao Fu recommended his talent and appointed him Right Remonstrance Officer to compile history, but because his mother was frail and aged he did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Fu recommended his talent and appointed him right remonstrance officer to compile history, but because his mother was frail and aged he did not go.

sentences.zh: 杜佑辟淮南掌書記，召為監察御史，轉右補闕、翰林學士、皇太子諸王侍讀。

translations.literal: Du You recruited him as recorder of Huainan, summoned him as Investigating Censor, transferred him to Right Supplementation Censor, Hanlin Academician, and Reader to the Crown Prince and Princes.
translations.idiomatic: Du You recruited him as recorder of Huainan, summoned him as investigating censor, transferred him to right supplementation censor, Hanlin academician, and reader to the crown prince and princes.

sentences.zh: 卒，年四十一，贈禮部郎中。

translations.literal: He died, aged forty-one, and was posthumously granted Bureau Director in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He died at forty-one and was posthumously made bureau director in the ministry of rites.
